title: Helping others
instructionsHu: Nézd meg a két kép leírását. Írd le és hasonlítsd össze a képeket, fejtsd ki a véleményedet a megadott szempontok alapján, majd beszélgess a vizsgáztatóval a segítségnyújtásról és a társadalmi felelősségvállalásról.

scenes.description: On a cold winter evening, a group of secondary school students are volunteering at a soup kitchen in a city centre. Wearing aprons and plastic gloves, they are serving hot soup and bread to a long line of homeless people. A teacher is organising the queue, and one boy is chatting with an old man who is holding a cup of tea in both hands. The students look serious but proud.

A young woman in her twenties is helping her elderly neighbour up the staircase of an old block of flats. She is carrying two heavy shopping bags, while the old lady is holding on to the handrail and talking to her. A small dog is following them up the stairs. It seems to be an everyday, informal favour between neighbours.

prompts: Compare the two ways of helping people shown in the pictures.
Why do people choose to help others, and what do they get in return?
Whose responsibility is it to take care of people in need: the state's, charities' or individuals'?
followUpQuestions: Do you think the compulsory community service for Hungarian secondary school students is a good idea? Why?
Why do some people find it difficult to ask for help?
Do people help their neighbours less today than in the past? Why?
What kinds of voluntary work would suit teenagers best?

usefulPhrases.en: give something back to the community
It gives you a sense of satisfaction.
